pages.text: Waiting for bricks to dry before firing them sure takes a long time. With the brick kiln, you can skip the drying and go straight to firing!$(br)$(br)The brick kiln is a multiblock that allows you to automate various kinds of firing. It requires a heat source below it.

pages.name: Brick Kiln
pages.text: Use the book to visualise how to build the brick kiln. You also need a brick firebox.
The kiln can also produce $(l:references/2fuels#coal_coke)coal coke$(), a better fuel than coal that burns longer, as well as producing charcoal.
